presets.name: Abay road repair detour
presets.description: Temporary repair works on Abay with detour and queue-risk evidence for a dossier.

graph: Close or heavily restrict matched Abay road segments during the work window.
demand: Reroute affected trips to parallel central corridors.
signal: No signal improvement assumed; temporary control may add delay.
speed: Apply speed factor 0.25 on affected work-zone links.
capacity: Apply capacity factor 0.05 on affected links.
cost: CAPEX placeholder covers temporary traffic management and signage.
risk: Queue spillback, public communication failure, and emergency access constraints.

assumptions: Repair work is temporary and localized to matched Abay links.
risks: Observed queue validation and detour compliance data are not attached.

presets.name: Abay accident response
presets.description: Short, severe capacity loss on Abay with response-time and reroute assumptions.

graph: Keep the road open but reduce capacity on matched incident links.
demand: Demand is unchanged; routing pressure shifts to nearby links.
signal: No signal retiming assumed unless operator action is added.
speed: Apply speed factor 0.4 on incident links.
capacity: Apply capacity factor 0.28 on incident links.
cost: OPEX placeholder covers response coordination only.
risk: Secondary collisions and blocked bus movements.

risks: No live incident feed or responder timestamp evidence is attached.

presets.name: Abay signal retiming
presets.description: Signal delay adjustment for the first Abay dossier path.

signal: Reduce signal delay by 4 seconds on matched Abay signalized links.
speed: Speed changes are indirect through reduced signal delay.
cost: CAPEX/OPEX placeholders match the first Abay dossier.
risk: Signal feasibility and safety approvals remain unverified.

assumptions: Retiming is a planning proxy, not a controller-ready timing plan.
risks: No observed before/after signal performance evidence is attached.

presets.name: Abay bus priority
presets.municipalLabel: Bus signal priority and queue jump
presets.description: Bus priority placeholder for reliability-sensitive corridor review.

demand: Bus passengers are represented through reliability proxy only.
signal: Reduce bus-priority signal delay by 3 seconds on matched links.
speed: Apply speed factor 1.04 on matched links.
cost: CAPEX placeholder covers priority equipment, markings, and enforcement.
risk: Needs bus AVL/headway evidence before stronger claims.

assumptions: Reliability benefit is proxy-only until bus data is attached.
risks: May reduce mixed-traffic capacity without enforcement.

presets.name: Abay dedicated bus lane
presets.description: Road-space reallocation to a dedicated bus lane on Abay.

graph: Keep links open and tag matched links as bus-lane candidates.
demand: Mode shift is not modeled; passenger benefit remains proxy.
signal: Minor signal delay reduction for buses is represented by -2 seconds.
speed: Apply speed factor 1.06 for bus-priority movement proxy.
cost: CAPEX placeholder covers lane markings, stops, and enforcement setup.
risk: General traffic queues may worsen if demand does not shift.

assumptions: Dedicated lane remains enforced during peak periods.
risks: Requires curb, parking, and enforcement approvals.

presets.name: Abay BRT connector
presets.description: Higher-cost BRT-style intervention for strategic comparison.

graph: Reserve matched corridor links for BRT-style priority treatment.
demand: Passenger demand response is not yet modeled.
signal: Reduce priority signal delay by 5 seconds on matched links.
speed: Apply speed factor 1.12 for transit movement proxy.
cost: CAPEX placeholder reflects stations, lanes, and ITS equipment.
risk: High capital cost and construction disruption.

assumptions: BRT benefit is strategic and proxy-only.
risks: Requires full feasibility, right-of-way, and ridership evidence.

presets.name: Abay school zone
presets.description: Time-window school-zone speed reduction and safety risk framing.

demand: School arrival demand is not explicitly modeled.
speed: Apply speed factor 0.72 in the school-zone time window.
cost: CAPEX placeholder covers signs, calming, and enforcement equipment.
risk: Mobility delay must be weighed against safety benefit not yet quantified.

assumptions: Safety benefit is described qualitatively until crash data is attached.
risks: Could worsen peak delay near schools.

presets.name: Snow weather peak
presets.description: Citywide weather speed reduction with secondary queue risk.

graph: Apply weather effect to a broad set of open roads.
demand: Demand unchanged unless paired with remote-work scenario.
capacity: Capacity factor records reduced discharge in bad weather.
cost: OPEX placeholder covers winter operations response.
risk: Weather severity and driver behavior are not calibrated.

assumptions: Weather event lasts 150 minutes during evening peak.
risks: No weather feed or observed speed comparison is attached.

presets.name: Central paid parking
presets.description: Parking and curb changes that reduce cruising but constrain curb access.

graph: Mark central curb corridors with parking-management capacity effect.
demand: Cruising-for-parking reduction is a proxy, not a demand model.
speed: Apply speed factor 0.94 for curb friction.
capacity: Apply capacity factor 0.92 on matched central links.
cost: CAPEX/OPEX placeholders cover meters, enforcement, and operations.
risk: Equity, enforcement, and spillover parking impacts need study.

assumptions: Parking search effects are represented as a proxy only.
risks: Revenue and compliance evidence is not attached.

presets.name: Central event surge
presets.municipalLabel: Mall, arena, or public-event demand surge
presets.description: Demand surge around central event locations with operator playbook hooks.

graph: No topology change; matched roads are tagged as event-impact links.
demand: Apply demand intensity 1.35 around event area in downstream runners.
speed: Apply speed factor 0.86 on affected links.
capacity: Apply capacity factor 0.9 for curb and pedestrian friction.
cost: OPEX placeholder covers temporary control and communications.
risk: Needs event schedule and crowd-management evidence.

assumptions: Event demand is a multiplier, not ticketing-derived demand.
risks: No live event calendar integration is attached.

presets.name: New development impact
presets.municipalLabel: New residential or mall development traffic impact
presets.description: Planning-review scenario for new development trips and mitigation costs.

graph: Tag growth-corridor roads and add signal-delay pressure.
demand: Apply demand intensity 1.18 for development-generated trips in downstream runners.
signal: Add 4 seconds of signal delay pressure on matched links.
speed: Apply speed factor 0.9 on affected links.
capacity: Apply capacity factor 0.94 on affected links.
cost: CAPEX placeholder covers mitigation contribution or access improvements.
risk: Trip generation and mitigation are not based on developer submissions yet.

assumptions: Demand impact is represented by a proxy intensity multiplier.
risks: Requires planning application data and access design.
